limits: This demonstrates eventual queued cancellation after a late callback, not atomic cancellation while that callback is executing.
Successful-listener control-plane test uses symbolic handles; actual network port binding and complete configuration transaction integration remain separate tests.
Snapshot certificates are metadata placeholders; no actual certificate/TLS handshake claim.
properties: Status reads real protected ETS and does not call a registered unresponsive manager.
Snapshot omits private config/key/chain/receipt/root markers and rejects writes by nonowner.
Read-time notBefore and expiry alter status/active_domains without depending on manager progress.
Owner death deletes status table and direct call yields typed DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE rather than stale readiness.
Missing/crashing renew callee produces bounded error without caller death; missing prepare/discard contained.
Actual10s prepare timeout returns unavailable, late fake prebind is closed by the actual queued cancel message and old listener state preserved.
Cancelled reservation cannot activate, duplicate cancel is idempotent, consumed activation ticket cannot later close active symbolic handle.
All three named fixture processes were observed exited; no manager registered afterward.
scope: Actual TLS module public APIs, callbacks, protected ETS, caller timeouts and raw BEAM fixture processes only. No full app/Config server/OS listener/CA/client/guardian/provider execution.
test_seams: Replace prepare_listeners with one declared symbolic handle.
Replace activate_listeners with symbolic handle/state update and activation observation.
Replace gen_tcp.close calls with symbolic-close observations.
Expose actual private publish_status through one added test-only wrapper; no implementation replacement.
